extracted.name: Grillos Pickle Dip
extracted.description: This easy Pickle Dip recipe combines cream cheese, Greek yogurt, and sour cream with crunchy dill pickles and fresh herbs for the ultimate creamy, tangy appetizer. It takes 10 minutes and we enjoy it with kettle chips or fresh veggies.
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 cups dill pickle chips (, diced (Grillo brand recommended))
1-2 Tablespoons pickle brine (, optional (to thin dip))
Kettle Chips (, for serving- (we love the Boulder Canyon Classic Kettle Chips))
instruction_lines: Beat cream cheese until smooth. Mix in Greek yogurt and sour cream. Stir in diced pickles, fresh dill, and seasonings. Add a splash of pickle brine, if desired, to make it thinner.
Chill for at least 30 minutes before serving, to allow the flavors to blend.
Serve with kettle chips (we love the Boulder Canyon Classic Kettle Chips), or veggies.
